mapper.update:
UPDATE study_tour_plan
plan_name = #{planName},
base_id = #{baseId},
route = #{route},
brief_intro = #{briefIntro},
details = #{details},
suitable_crowd = #{suitableCrowd},
duration = #{duration},
status = #{status},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT stp.id, stp.plan_name AS planName, stp.base_id AS baseId, stp.route, stp.brief_intro AS briefIntro, stp.details, stp.suitable_crowd AS suitableCrowd, stp.duration, stp.status, stp.create_time AS createTime, stp.update_time AS updateTime FROM study_tour_plan stp
INNER JOIN study_tour_base stb ON stp.base_id = stb.id
WHERE stp.status = 1
AND stb.user_id = #{merchantUserId}
ORDER BY stp.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_images ( related_id, related_type, image_url, image_name, sort_order, is_cover, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{relatedId}, #{relatedType}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageName}, #{sortOrder}, #{isCover}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, related_id AS relatedId, related_type AS relatedType, image_url AS imageUrl, image_name AS imageName, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_cover AS isCover, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM study_images WHERE related_id = #{planId} AND related_type = 'plan' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM study_images WHERE related_id = #{planId} AND related_type = 'plan'
mapper.update: UPDATE study_images SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id};
